class Base { protected constructor() {} }
class Derived extends Base {}
new Derived();
class GrandChild extends Derived {}
new GrandChild();
class Outsider { make() { return new Derived(); } }
const Alias = Base;
class FromAlias extends Alias {}
new FromAlias();
class Overloaded { protected constructor(x: number); protected constructor(x: any) {} }
class FromOverloaded extends Overloaded {}
new FromOverloaded(1);
abstract class Shape { protected constructor() {} }
class Square extends Shape {}
new Square();
const make = () => new Derived();
